Flow A · prompts tick as answers are heard
Flow A · an empty prior-service outcome blocks and asks
Flow B · dictation stays the staffer's own facts: no template, no invented times, events or outcomes
Flow B · a named objective is used; an unnamed one is a question
Flow B · negative case: "observed" is flagged and a question is raised; the words are not changed
Units · official bands: 0 below 120 minutes, 1/2/3 at 120/180/300; the 60-minute rule is an alternate, not the default

the bridge source: message shapes, origin checks, no clicks, no background fetch to Lauris, same copy in extension/
what the bridge reports is accepted from the Lauris origin only with a JSON body (the bridge posts exactly this)
both presets start on Oct 29; Psyflo and the mock Lauris print the same date
advancing the day moves Psyflo AND Lauris together; the default skips the weekend
a Lauris stamp uses the same clock (a form processed after the advance is dated that day)
the time of day is not the machine clock and is never silently pinned (fixed only through DEMO_TIME)
PDU-02 an information request that is not answered becomes "missed" (no 08:40 fudge); the reply-due time is shown
PDU-01/06 decision clock: "Day N", follow-up on day 10, overdue only after the configured window; each number has a source
the seeded overdue request (R-0399) is overdue by the rule, not by a constant
EXA-04 appeal window: computed from the notice date (60 days, unverified, confirm on the letter); closed after it, never negative
deadlines return the date, the source and the verification label from the rules table
no hard-coded story date in the foundation code (the Oct 29 literal, "Oct 29", 10/29, the 08:40 fudge)
T.N. approved at 150 after the peer-to-peer: 150 units, a new window, the old 65 of 65 kept as history
the task closes only when the page bridge shows the units in Lauris (a person entered them)
T.W. and E.C. become Active WITH units (demo reply approved on a sent request)
accepting a partial (D.W. 110 of 150) sets 110 units; M.R. continued stay award replaces 83 of 110 with a new window
request.demoReply never approves a draft or anything that was not sent; presenter mode is required
R-0391 (J.O.) turns overdue under the clock service, like R-0399
/api/state and the roster never serve a screening transcript to an unauthenticated caller
the phone timer follows store.clock, not the machine clock

scripted call: prompts tick while recording; the draft fills the boxes; only what was said

ISP: the three goals are filled; Process Form drafts the request (R-0416)
SRA: drafted from the call and the school counts; criterion 3 and trauma-informed care left blank; no invented dates or promises
Process Form lands in Pending clinical approval (observed, with the Harvest # and session)
the approver records the approval; then Get Signature in Lauris is observed: the signer is the Lauris user
Send is a person's action (session actor); the receipt is the simulated Sfax stub
no console errors
WPS-01 a Lauris record with an unknown Harvest # is never matched by initials: no draft, no note, dictation stays waiting
WPS-02 the right Harvest # with the wrong initials on the page is a hard stop (audited), nothing applied
WPS-03 no default person: an unknown or missing Lauris user, Harvest # or session records nothing
WPS-04 a forged event (no such session, or another user) is not believed
WPS-05 a timer or dictation for a student off the caseload is refused
WPS-08 a portal confirmation needs its request, and an issued reference
MCS-01 Process Form (observed) lands in Pending clinical approval; nothing can be signed or sent from a client call
MCS-02 a second Process Form for the same request is an anomaly, not a second processed state
MCS-03 a direct-support user cannot sign in Lauris, and a forged signed event is not believed
MCS-07 signed in Lauris BEFORE the internal approval: held, not marked signed, Send blocked
MCS-08 approval: only a designated approver; the signer on the signed PDF and the events is the one read from Lauris
SIGNED is final: a second signature event or a reject after signing is refused (Lauris and Psyflo)
MCS-09 send: a person with send.packet presses it; the actor is the session, never args.by; the event is simulated, not "Sfax"
PS-2 the portal confirmation attaches only to its request and an issued reference
PDU-01 the decision clock is "Day N" with the configured window and a source; the date comes from the rules table
GT-6 a re-send is a distinct action with a reason; it never resets the first send date
SVR-01 fax: Send by a person -> simulated Sfax; events carry sim:true and the person, never an actor called "Sfax"
PS-1 an overdue notice or a guardian signature is not a send: "sent" is recorded only when the Send stub ran
EFN-01..03 Lauris: a processed session cannot be written, processed again, or opened for editing
EFN-04 Psyflo: a repeated processed event for a session changes nothing; the note stays unchanged
IIU-09 units must follow the recorded direct time: a note with 3 units on 100 minutes is flagged for review
EFN-05 consent: a second signature is kept as a new version, the first record and file stay
EFN-06/07 a sent reply is write-once; patch actions and record rewrites are refused
payer decisions need a document reference and are write-once (a correction needs a reason and appends)
IIU-03/04/05/06 invalid units, dates and results are refused
URA note review: not your own note; a decision is write-once; only the assigned reviewer or a supervisor
presenter actions are refused without presenter mode; the demo reply is recorded as simulated with a demo reference
DSL-04 the internal quarterly is staff only: absent from every other projection
RE-4 guardian appeal: signing is not sending; a person presses Send and the stub returns the reference

no screening transcript reaches an unauthenticated caller: /api/state is 401, the roster is empty, the scripted call needs a session

action sweep: every action x every staff role gets 401/403 exactly when the matrix says no
presenter controls need presenter mode, not only a role
user.update: a role change is presenter-only; designations go through two people
projection: direct support sees only their caseload; no screenings, drafts, versions, fills, other staff notes
projection: admin sees unit balances and authorization status but no clinical text
projection: supervisor sees status and their reviewees' notes; clinician sees clinical text

service line: outpatient (P.G., R-0377) never appears in the staff state
portal sessions: a guardian sees one child; a school user sees their own school; neither can use staff actions
files need a session and the right role
cross-origin: JSON only and an origin allow-list on state-changing calls
presenter PIN and DEMO_PRESENTER are honoured by sign-in
